title: Agent tool-call checks become runnable autotests
requirement: The checks an agent performs by calling tools (a Playwright UX/UI walk, a benchmark run read for p95/throughput) must become autotests the library executes and gates on - with typed metric thresholds and captured artifacts - instead of record-only claims that a run happened.
reason: No execution layer exists yet: the requirement is captured from the owner's request and specified in docs/CASE-LIBRARY-DESIGN.md; the automated checks it asks for are the deliverable, not an existing surface to run.
steps: Implement phases P0-P3 of docs/CASE-LIBRARY-DESIGN.md (honesty pass, runner, typed checks, suite/gate).
Run a benchmark case whose driver reports p95 212 ms against a 250 ms threshold (expect verified) and one reporting 260 ms (expect failing with the delta).
Run a UI driver whose summary reports one serious axe violation (expect failing) and one with zero (expect verified).
Close a task whose linked case is failing and observe the refusal naming the case.
expected: A case_run executes the stored command; a typed check such as p95 <= 250 ms or axe violations <= 0 marks the case verified or failing from the measured value; a suite gates task close (and make verify) on a failing case; the design is docs/CASE-LIBRARY-DESIGN.md.
